name: Wish Radar
description: Track personal wishes, recorded price changes and deal alerts in a private INR ledger. Public merchant reads use the governed Web pages integration; live coverage varies by store.
author: Vakyartha

web__fetch_page.reason: Read merchant search candidates and selected product pages for explicit or scheduled price checks. Manual records remain local.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.title: Read tracked wishes & deals
tools.description: Read active wishes, target prices, latest observed prices in INR, deal statuses, star ratings, delivery speeds, destination PIN code, and current expectedRevision for remembering updates.

filter.description: Filter by 'all' (default), 'deals' (items at or below target), or 'drops' (recent price drops)

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. Electronics, Beauty & Personal Care)

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.title: Read price history & comparisons
tools.description: Read historical price observations, star ratings, delivery speeds, and cross-merchant price comparisons from the local DuckDB ledger.

wishId.description: Optional wish item ID to inspect history for a specific item

itemTitle.description: Optional item title to search for if wishId is not known

limit.description: Maximum number of observations to return (default 20)

tools.name: get_broadcast_script
tools.title: Generate broadcast TTS & Watch script
tools.description: Generate an audio-visual studio production script and structured Watch programme with presenter tone cues, theme music beds, video lower thirds, dynamic charts, and crawling live ticker for Wish Radar.

format.description: Format to return: 'script' (TTS studio production markdown), 'programme' (structured JSON segments & ticker for Watch player), or 'both' (default)

tools.name: remember_wish
tools.title: Remember new wish
tools.description: Add and track a new wish in Wish Radar with target price in INR, preferred merchant, delivery PIN, optional direct URL, and personal timing notes. Requires current expectedRevision from get_wishlist.

id.description: Optional existing wish id to update

targetPrice.description: Optional target price in Indian Rupees (e.g. 1499 or 1499.50)

notes.description: Personal notes or sale timing notes

tools.name: record_price
tools.title: Remember price check
tools.description: Log an observed price check, star rating, delivery speed, PIN code and current offer notes into the DuckDB price ledger. Requires current expectedRevision from get_wishlist.

wishId.description: ID of the tracked wish item (or use itemTitle)

itemTitle.description: Item title to match if wishId is not known

price.description: Observed price in Indian Rupees (e.g. 1299 or 1299.50)

inStock.description: Whether the product is currently in stock (default true)

ratingCount.description: Number of customer ratings or reviews (e.g. 17,381)

deliveryInfo.description: Delivery speed or promised date (e.g. FREE delivery by Friday)

offerNotes.description: Current deal, bank offer, coupon or festival note

tools.name: check_amazon_price
tools.title: Check merchant price or find Amazon candidates
tools.description: Read a linked merchant product through Web pages. Without a link, Amazon wishes discover candidates for personal selection; search alone never records an observation. Other merchants require a direct product link. Access challenges and unreadable or ambiguous prices remain failures. Requires current expectedRevision.

wishId.description: ID of the tracked wish item (or use itemTitle)

itemTitle.description: Item title to match if wishId is not known

tools.name: remove_wish
tools.title: Remove tracked wish
tools.description: Remove a wish from Wish Radar and clean up all its historical price observations from DuckDB. Requires expectedRevision.

wishId.description: ID of the tracked wish item to remove (or use itemTitle)

itemTitle.description: Item title to match if wishId is not known

skills.name: wish-radar-advisor
skills.description: Evaluate price trends, calculate savings in Indian Rupees, and advise on deals across Indian stores
